authorization.context: Repository owner requested publication after receiving the pre-release report: engineering checks passed; two current verified samples, one known semantic failure and thirteen incomplete current-case evidence decisions; no blanket waiver existed before this request.
authorization.interpretation: Proceed with a limited-evidence patch release and explicitly record release-only waivers. This is not an instruction to rewrite model outcomes.

scope: Publish the reviewed locked skill content and workflow/example fixes through the existing main-branch trusted-publishing workflow.
releaseLimitations: Known review-readonly semantic failure remains: current tested model repeatedly produced unsupported definite-bug claims, including a Promise.race late-rejection crash claim contradicted by the local probe. Independently validate review findings before taking action.
Thirteen cases retain historical or incomplete current evidence. No full host/model/mode matrix or reliable general model-review claim is made.
Measured optimization control remains partial. The original optimization case pass is narrower than production performance validation.
Real browser, assistive technology, Java/MyBatis/target database integration and real-project expansion trial remain unverified.

dispositions.rationale: Release-only waiver of the current-evidence gap, following the informed publication request. Historical results and limitations remain unchanged; no fabricated current pass.
